settings_open_failed: Could not open the settings window: {error}
password_warning_title: Save passwords to the local credential file?
password_warning_detail: Credential storage is set to Local configuration file. This server's server and SASL passwords will be stored unencrypted in {path}, readable only by your user account.
disable_sasl_first: Turn off SASL before disabling TLS.
no_servers_hint: Open the server list and add IRCnet or another server.
connection_intro: Choose a server. The nickname, channels and sign-in below belong to that server; several servers can be connected at once.
remove_server_detail: It will be disconnected if connected, and its saved passwords will be deleted.
encoding_hint: Messages and channel names use this server's character encoding.
certificate_warning: Without certificate verification, the server cannot be authenticated.
whois_open_failed: Could not open the WHOIS window: {error}
event_retry_refused: Automatic reconnection is off because the server refused authentication or these settings. Check the settings and reconnect.
appearance_intro: Use #RRGGBB colors. Type in a font field to filter choices; leave it empty for the default.
palette_remove_hint: Click to use, right-click to remove
channel_number_modifier_hint: Modifier for jumping to the first through tenth channel. Choose Alt or Super when the desktop uses Ctrl+number for workspaces. Server numbers stay Ctrl+Alt+1..0.
text_key_theme_hint: Follow GTK uses Emacs keys when the desktop's gtk-key-theme is Emacs. Emacs mode adds Ctrl+A/E/B/F/D/H/K/U/W/Y and Alt+B/F/D; Select All moves to Ctrl+/ and Redo stays on Ctrl+Shift+Z.
linux_display_hint: Takes effect after restarting. On GNOME, X11 (XWayland) shows the desktop's own title bar; Wayland keeps native input methods and sharp fractional scaling. CAYENCHAT_DISPLAY=x11 or wayland overrides this.
image_previews_hint: Shows small thumbnails of direct PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP links in the channel log. While on, CayenChat downloads the linked images for the lines on screen from their servers; the link text stays as it is.
wrap_long_nicknames: Wrap long nicknames instead of shortening them
user_avatars_hint: Shows a small picture beside nicknames in the channel log and the member list when the network supplies one. While on, CayenChat downloads the pictures of the users on screen from their servers. On IRC, avatars also need "User avatars (experimental)" on the server's IRCv3 tab.
language_hint: System language follows your operating system; other languages use English.
diagnostics_heading: Connection diagnostics (→ sent / ← received; includes message bodies)
port_invalid: Port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
event_nick_rejected: The server rejected nickname {nickname} (in use or invalid). Enter another nickname.
wait_join: Wait until the channel is joined before sending.
select_channel: Select a channel before sending a message.
not_connected: Disconnected; open Connection Settings to connect.
draft_placeholder: Message draft — Enter sends, / starts a command
mock_placeholder: Message draft — offline mock, sending disabled
username_hint: Sent in the IRC USER command. It is separate from the nickname and from the SASL account.
event_realname_unsupported: The server does not support SETNAME; the new real name is used from the next connection.
event_realname_busy: Too many real name changes are waiting for the server.
event_realname_rejected: The server rejected the real name: {reason}
server_password_hint: Sent with PASS before registration. This is not the SASL password.
plaintext_pass: Send the server password without TLS
plaintext_pass_warning: The server password is sent unencrypted. Use this only on a trusted network, such as a bouncer on your own LAN.
plaintext_pass_title: Send the server password without TLS?
plaintext_pass_detail: Without TLS, the server password is sent in plain text and anyone who can observe the network can read it. Allow this only for a server on a trusted network, such as your own bouncer.
credential_error_unavailable: The selected credential storage cannot be used ({error}). Choose a location under Settings → Credential Storage.
legacy_migrated: Saved passwords were moved out of the settings file into the credential storage.
legacy_migrated_local: System secure storage is unavailable, so saved passwords were moved out of the settings file into the local credential file. You can change this under Settings → Credential Storage.
credentials_intro: Server passwords, SASL passwords and image hosting accounts are stored separately from other settings.
credential_system_linux: The desktop's Secret Service (GNOME Keyring, KWallet or another provider).
credential_local_detail: Less secure. Credentials are stored unencrypted on this computer in {path}. Only your user account can read the file, but any program running as you, and any backup of it, can read them.
credential_system_unavailable: System secure storage is not available ({error}). You can store credentials in a local configuration file instead.
credential_switch_title: Store credentials in a local file?
credential_switch_detail: Credentials will be stored unencrypted in {path}. This is less secure than system secure storage.
credential_switched: Credential storage changed; {count} saved item(s) moved.
credential_switched_source_unavailable: Credential storage changed. Items in the previous location could not be read, so they were not moved.
image_upload_intro: Images you paste or drop into an IRC draft can be uploaded to an image hosting account you own. IRC itself only receives the resulting link as text.
image_upload_privacy: Uploaded images are kept by the hosting service, not by IRC. Anyone who obtains a link may be able to view the image, including people outside the channel; channel membership does not control access.
image_token_placeholder: Paste the API key or token
image_setup_imgbb: ImgBB connects with the API key of your ImgBB account: sign in at api.imgbb.com, choose Get API key, and paste the key here. CayenChat keeps it in the credential storage.
upload_confirm_detail:
“{name}” ({size}) will leave this computer and be sent to {provider}, an external image hosting service. It is not an IRC attachment: a link is added to your draft, and you decide whether to send it.

Anyone who obtains the link may be able to view the image, including people outside this channel. Channel membership does not control access.
upload_not_configured_detail: To send images from IRC, connect an image hosting account.
upload_reconnect_detail: {provider} did not accept the saved account credentials, or none are saved. Reconnect the account to upload images.
upload_done: Image uploaded; the link was added to the draft.
upload_cancelled: Upload cancelled. If the transfer had already finished, the image may still exist on {provider}.
upload_busy: An image upload is already in progress.
upload_failed_network: Could not reach {provider} ({error}). The draft was not changed.
upload_failed_rejected: {provider} rejected the image ({error}). The draft was not changed.
upload_failed_too_large: The image is larger than the {limit} upload limit.
upload_not_image: Only PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, TIFF, HEIC/HEIF or AVIF images can be uploaded.
upload_one_file: Drop one image at a time.
upload_drop_hint: Drop an image to upload it
notify_mentions: When someone mentions my nickname in a channel (e.g. nick: or @nick)
notify_private_messages: When I receive a private message
notify_keywords: When a channel message contains a keyword
keywords_hint: Comma-separated. Matched anywhere in a message, ignoring case. Add your nickname here only if you also want it matched inside other words.
notifications_hint: Messages in the selected channel of the focused chat window do not notify.
notifications_hint_macos: Messages in the selected channel of the focused chat window do not notify. macOS shows notifications only for the app bundle; allow them in System Settings > Notifications.
ircv3_intro: Optional IRCv3 extensions, chosen for each server. Each stays off until you turn it on.
ircv3_no_server: Add a server on the Connection tab first.
ircv3_server_time_hint: Show the time the server recorded for incoming messages (server-time), in local time. Works without message tags.
ircv3_message_tags_hint: Accept IRCv3 message tags from the server (message-tags). Tag-only messages (TAGMSG) are not shown.
ircv3_batch_hint: Receive grouped messages (batch), so history a server or bouncer replays (chathistory, znc.in/playback) is recognized and does not notify. Other kinds of batches are shown as usual.
ircv3_legacy_encoding: This server uses {encoding}. Message tags are not requested because tag values are UTF-8; server timestamps still work.
ircv3_next_connection: Changes take effect the next time this server connects. A connected server is not reconnected.
ircv3_avatar_waiting_publish: Sending… waiting for the server's answer.
ircv3_avatar_waiting_remove: Removing… waiting for the server's answer.
ircv3_avatar_removed: Removed: the server confirmed that no avatar is set.
ircv3_avatar_rate_limited: The server is limiting changes. Try again in {seconds} s.
ircv3_avatar_rate_limited_later: The server is limiting changes. Try again later.
ircv3_avatar_no_reply: The server did not answer. The avatar may or may not have changed.
ircv3_avatar_unavailable: The avatar cannot be sent to this IRC server now.
ircv3_avatar_busy: Another avatar request is still waiting for the server.
ircv3_avatar_capability_lost: The server stopped avatar metadata before answering.
ircv3_avatar_connection_lost: The connection ended before the server answered.
ircv3_avatar_not_sent: The request could not be sent: {error}
ircv3_avatar_invalid: Enter a web address (http or https) without spaces or control characters.
ircv3_avatar_credentials: This URL contains a user name, password or token-like parameter, so it is not sent.
ircv3_avatar_blocked: Other users could not load this URL: use http or https on the default port with a public host name.
ircv3_avatar_too_long: This URL is too long to send (at most {max} bytes).
ircv3_avatar_ascii_only: This server's encoding allows only avatar URLs written in plain ASCII.
ircv3_avatar_upload_bad_url: The image host returned a URL that cannot be used as an avatar.
ircv3_avatar_upload_server_gone: The server this image was for has been removed; the URL was not kept.
ircv3_avatar_upload_needs_setup: No image upload account is set up. Set one up on the Image Upload tab, or type a URL.
ircv3_avatar_upload_reconnect: Reconnect your {provider} account on the Image Upload tab, or type a URL.
ircv3_avatar_upload_cancelled: Stopped waiting for the upload. The image may still reach the host.
ircv3_avatar_edit_unsupported: This image format cannot be edited here. Use PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP or TIFF (for example, export HEIC photos as JPEG).
ircv3_avatar_edit_too_large: This image is too large to open (at most 8192 pixels a side and about 16 megapixels).
ircv3_avatar_edit_unreadable: This image could not be read.
ircv3_avatar_uploaded_not_sent: Uploaded, but the avatar could not be sent to the IRC server.
ircv3_avatar_exposure: Sending shows this URL to everyone on this network, and the server may keep it. Never include passwords or access tokens.
ircv3_avatar_remove_title: Remove your avatar from the IRC server?
ircv3_avatar_remove_detail: Other users on this network will no longer see it. The URL stays in the field.
ircv3_avatar_unsupported: This IRC server does not support avatars.
ircv3_confirmed_sending_hint: Show your message at once, then let the server confirm it (echo-message, labeled-response): the server's final text and time replace it, and messages the server rejects are marked. Also shows what other clients of the same account send.
ircv3_accounts_hint: Follow the services accounts and real names of channel members (account-notify, extended-join, WHOX) and show them in WHOIS. Asks the server for the members of each joined channel once.
ircv3_chathistory_hint: On joining a channel, ask the server for up to 50 recent lines (draft/chathistory) and show them without notifying. Servers that support it are also asked for timestamps and batches.
ircv3_peer_avatars_hint: Exchange avatar URLs with other clients such as KVIrc, where the server has no avatar metadata. People who speak are looked up with WHO and asked only if they have an avatar. Nothing of yours is shared until you choose Share with Peers.
ircv3_peer_share_exposure: Anyone on this network who asks gets this URL, and after reconnecting your real name shows that you have an avatar. Never include passwords or access tokens.
ircv3_peer_reconnect: Reconnect to update the avatar mark in your real name.
ircv3_peer_size_placeholder: Other clients do not fill in {size}; share a URL without it.
debug_log_hint: Changes take effect immediately and are saved for the next launch. Existing files are appended to. Disable logging after troubleshooting; the file keeps growing while enabled. Review logs before sharing them.
debug_log_picker_failed: Could not open the log file chooser.
